name: THE PATRONS
note: A drinker above the counter, redrawn in Thad’s idiom. Texture 7.66 to 4.90 against Thad’s 6.09 -- the first figure in the game to reach him, and slightly past. All four rules held first time: below the counter 0.47, three separable bands, each moving in exactly one pose and 0.0 in the others. The seated man turns his head to look into the room.

sprite.note: A beat, not a loop. Tyler: they are not moving enough. Intervals roughly halved and kept mutually prime so they still drift apart rather than falling into a pattern -- 5, 7, 4 at the table and 6, 4.5, 8 at the bar. With six figures on those intervals somebody moves about every three-quarters of a second.
